notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
v1.2

notes.title: Small fix update v1.1.2
notes.content:

* The chair has been removed in the subway.
* Fixed a few minor issues with the ticket robot.
* Fixed some other small bugs.

* Fixed some other bugs and glitches
